revisionDesc.change: Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - Good new reading. Cf. τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς ἀμ|β̣[λ]υωπησαντα in P.Rein. 2 113 lines 9-10.

Submit - l. 14 αβλοιοσων -> αβλοιοπων (l. ἀμβλυωπῶν). The letter after αμβλοιο is π; cf. the same letter in the l. 12 above υπερ. For the verb ἀμβλυωπέω,"to be dim-sighted" see LSJ s.v.. with references to, Hp.Prog.7, X.Cyn.5.27 codd., Men.908, LXX 3 Ki.12.24, Sor.1.82, Plu.2.53f, etc.; un-Attic acc. to Harp., etc.
